question: To travel to Beijing, you can take one of 2 flights or 3 high-speed trains. After arriving, you choose 1 of 4 hotels. How many arrangements are possible?
solution: Add the transportation options to get \(5\), then multiply by the number of hotels, \(4\), to get \(20\).
